title: HELIX Terminology: EEO/IPEDS Occupational Category
description: Employee occupational categories used for Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) reporting and IPEDS Human Resources survey submissions.

codes.definition: Senior institutional officers with significant management responsibilities: president, provost, vice presidents, deans, directors. IPEDS new categories map this to: Management Occupations (SOC 11-0000).

Persons with academic rank (professor, associate professor, assistant professor, instructor, lecturer) whose primary assignment is instruction, research, or public service. Includes tenure-track, tenured, and non-tenure-track faculty reported in IPEDS.

Non-faculty employees in positions requiring a bachelor's degree or higher. Includes advisors, counselors, librarians, IT professionals, accountants, HR specialists, student affairs professionals, coaches, and research staff without faculty rank.

Support staff in office and administrative roles: administrative assistants, office managers, data entry, receptionists, records clerks. Aligns with IPEDS Office and Administrative Support Occupations (SOC 43-0000).

Workers in technical roles typically requiring specialized training or an associate degree: lab technicians, IT support, library paraprofessionals, medical technicians, engineering technicians. Aligns with IPEDS Healthcare Practitioners, Computer/Engineering/Science Technicians.

Workers in trades requiring apprenticeship or vocational training: electricians, plumbers, HVAC technicians, carpenters, painters, groundskeepers. Aligns with IPEDS Construction, Installation/Maintenance/Repair Occupations.

Workers in building maintenance, custodial, food service, public safety, transportation, and similar operational roles. Aligns with IPEDS Service Occupations (SOC 31-0000, 33-0000, 35-0000, 37-0000, 39-0000, 53-0000).
